title: campylospermum reticulatum var. turnerae
intro: Campylospermum reticulatum var. turnerae, commonly known as Turnera retusa, is a plant species belonging to the Passifloraceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce pain and fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Turnera retusa include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria and fungi, and exhibit antispasmodic and analgesic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
